description: This file defines a Java class 'ExternalServicesPropertiesCommandFromApiJsonDeserializer' responsible for deserializing and validating JSON configuration data for external service integrations (S3, SMTP, SMS, Notification) within the Fineract project, utilizing Gson for JSON handling and Spring for dependency injection.

classes.name: ExternalServicesPropertiesCommandFromApiJsonDeserializer
classes.description: A Spring component class that deserializes and validates JSON configurations for different external services, supporting services such as S3, SMTP, SMS, and notifications. It utilizes helper methods for JSON parsing and parameter validation, and throws exceptions if invalid or unsupported configurations are detected.

methods.name: validateForUpdate
methods.description: Validates the provided JSON string for the specified external service name, checking for unsupported parameters and throwing exceptions if JSON is invalid or service name is unrecognized.

methods.name: getNameKeys
methods.description: Extracts and returns the set of keys from the provided JSON string, representing the parameter names in the configuration.
